name: Vampiro por Navidad
source:
In a cold, dark place, a lonely man opens his eyes. He can't see, he can't move, and his only companion is his own breathing, and an ominous stench. He is desperate, there is no hope for the prisoner...

Suddenly, a door opens, roaring like a thunder, and the very instant that man stepped in, the prisoner's life became hell...

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29656]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
在寒冷黑暗的地方，一个孤独男人睁开眼睛。他看不见，无法移动，唯一的同伴是自己的呼吸与不祥恶臭。囚犯绝望至极，看不到任何希望……

突然，门像雷鸣般轰然打开，那男人踏入的瞬间，囚犯的生活变成了地狱……

[译自[url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29656]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
